Name: Azariah, Son of Oded
Summary: Azariah, son of Oded, met Asa with the word that the LORD is with His people while they are with Him, and Asa took courage and put away idols.
KeyStory: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded, and his message moved Asa to renew the altar and gather Judah into covenant.
RelatedPeople: King Asa; Oded, Father of Azariah
LifeLesson: A timely word from God can turn a king's heart back to covenant faithfulness.
